name: – After § 1 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 1a. Condemns in the strongest possible terms the executive measures issued by President Trump on 29 January 2026 and the secondary sanctions on 1 May 2026, which constitute an escalation of economic warfare against the Cuban people and a direct attack on European economic sovereignty;
